englishTranslations.guide.faq.connectedCharacters.title: When should I link a character?
englishTranslations.guide.faq.energy.p1: Plan around one or two outcomes that matter most right now. Rest and focus often beat chaotic activity.
englishTranslations.guide.faq.energy.title: How do I manage energy better?
englishTranslations.guide.faq.genres.p1: Format is the package, genre is the audience promise, and tone is how the story feels moment to moment.
englishTranslations.guide.faq.genres.title: What is the difference between format, genre, and tone?
englishTranslations.guide.faq.health.p1: Care Team is weekly prevention and light handling for small issues. Health Clinic is direct treatment for active conditions and serious problems.
englishTranslations.guide.faq.health.title: Why do I need Care Team and Health Clinic?
englishTranslations.guide.faq.legacy.p1: Build more than one pillar. Career, money, relationships, and long-term choices create stronger late-game saves.
englishTranslations.guide.faq.legacy.title: How do I keep a save strong for the long term?
englishTranslations.guide.faq.loans.p1: Loans help when they unlock a clear move, but monthly payment pressure continues until the balance is handled.
englishTranslations.guide.faq.loans.title: How should I think about loans?
englishTranslations.guide.faq.marketing.p1: Marketing boosts demand, but it cannot replace fundamentals like stock, staffing, pricing, and positioning.
englishTranslations.guide.faq.marketing.title: Why does marketing not always explode sales?
englishTranslations.guide.faq.relationship.p1: Relationships need attention over time. Long neglect creates strain, especially during career or business pressure.
englishTranslations.guide.faq.relationship.title: Why did my relationship get worse?
englishTranslations.guide.faq.roles.p1: Bigger roles come from the full picture, not one stat. Improve talent, reputation, preparation, experience, and representation together.
englishTranslations.guide.faq.roles.title: Why am I not getting bigger roles?
englishTranslations.guide.faq.scriptQuality.p1: Script quality is shaped by development choices, creative identity, genre fit, story direction, and package coherence.
englishTranslations.guide.faq.scriptQuality.title: Why did my script quality change?
englishTranslations.guide.faq.sequelCast.p1: Returning cast helps continuity and audience recognition, but they still need to be brought into the new production properly.
englishTranslations.guide.faq.sequelCast.title: Why do sequels care about old cast?
englishTranslations.guide.faq.sponsor.p1: Active contracts still need follow-through. Check the Team app and complete required actions on time.
englishTranslations.guide.faq.sponsor.title: Why did I lose a sponsorship or take a fine?
englishTranslations.guide.faq.stats.p1: Fame is how known you are. Followers are your social audience. Reputation is how trusted and respected you are professionally.
englishTranslations.guide.faq.stats.title: What is the difference between fame, followers, and reputation?
englishTranslations.guide.faq.streaming.p1: Releases move through stages. Theatrical runs end, and outcomes can push a title toward the next release phase.
englishTranslations.guide.faq.streaming.title: Why did my movie leave theaters or move on?
englishTranslations.guide.faq.studio.p1: Your studio performs best when the pipeline is healthy: development, production, release timing, and catalog building.
englishTranslations.guide.faq.studio.title: How does the production house really work?

englishTranslations.guide.handbook.businesses.p1: Businesses are long-term income engines. Some are steady service businesses, while product businesses reward hands-on management.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.businesses.p2: Pricing, quality, hype, staffing, stock, and expansion all matter.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.businesses.p3: Marketing works best when product, capacity, and setup are already healthy.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.businesses.title: Businesses
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.career.p1: CastLink is the main place to find work. Better talent, preparation, experience, and representation improve the quality of roles you can compete for.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.career.p2: Preparation matters. Rehearsals and smart role selection make performances more consistent.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.career.p3: Early game builds a record, mid game builds momentum, and late game is about leverage, choice, and legacy.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.career.title: Career Flow
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.developmentLab.noteBody: The guide explains what matters, not the hidden math. Strong concepts usually come from fit, clarity, and timing.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.developmentLab.p1: Vault stores saved scripts and concepts until you are ready to develop, sell, or produce them.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.developmentLab.p2: Concept is where you shape genre, tone, audience, and story identity.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.developmentLab.p3: Market is where scripts can be bought or discovered. Watch format, genre, quality, and any known subject or franchise hook.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.developmentLab.title: Development Lab
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.finance.p1: Cash flow matters. Large paydays feel great, but weekly expenses decide whether the account stays healthy.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.finance.p2: Assets and lifestyle choices can improve life quality and image, but buying too much too early can slow progress.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.finance.p3: Loans create monthly pressure. Watch the balance, payment, and future flexibility.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.finance.p4: Diversify when possible. Long runs are safer with multiple income pillars.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.finance.title: Money, Assets & Lifestyle
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.gettingStarted.p1: Your first goal is reliable momentum. Small wins in auditions, social activity, and money management usually beat risky all-in plays at the start.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.gettingStarted.p2: Think week to week. Every decision competes for time and energy, and spreading too thin slows progress everywhere.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.gettingStarted.p3: Use the phone apps often. CastLink grows your career, Team handles contracts, social apps build reach, and Guide explains the rest.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.greenlight.b1: Use the cast step to lock who plays each role.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.greenlight.b2: Use connected characters when the story belongs to a franchise or universe.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.greenlight.b3: Use the review step to catch weak spots before committing.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.greenlight.p1: Greenlight turns a script into a production plan with director, cast, crew, gear, locations, tone, and final package.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.greenlight.p2: Budget is not just a number. Talent fees, crew quality, production choices, known characters, and scale all move it.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.greenlight.p3: Negotiation matters. Returning cast and bigger names can be powerful, but they still need deals.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.greenlight.title: Greenlight Flow
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.healthCare.b1: Care Team can quietly handle minor cold, flu, workload headache, or back-pain moments and show it in the live feed.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.healthCare.b2: Health Clinic still matters when a condition is active, severe, chronic, public, or needs proper treatment choices.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.healthCare.b3: Ignoring a small issue can let it worsen, so prevention saves money and attention without replacing real treatment.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.healthCare.noteBody: Care Team is the safety net you pay weekly for; Health Clinic is the deliberate action you take when the body actually needs care.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.healthCare.p1: Health issues are split between prevention and treatment. Your Care Team keeps small problems from interrupting the career too often.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.healthCare.p2: The Health Clinic is for active conditions: illness, burnout, injuries, sleep trouble, chronic pain, or serious screening follow-up.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.healthCare.p3: A strong save usually uses both. Staff reduce friction week to week, while clinic visits clear the issues already affecting health, work, or recovery.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.healthCare.title: Health, Care Team & Clinic
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.legacy.p1: Actor Empire rewards long saves. Careers rise and fall, businesses mature, and family choices reshape the run.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.legacy.p2: Legacy is continuity. Your choices now shape what the next chapter inherits.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.legacy.p3: Strong dynasties combine status, wealth, stability, and relationships.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.legacy.title: Legacy & Long-Term Play
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.productionHouse.p1: Think in stages: development, production, release, and afterlife all matter.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.productionHouse.p2: Not every project should be rushed. Stronger planning can beat forcing everything out quickly.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.productionHouse.p3: Your library matters. Over time, the studio becomes more valuable when you build a catalog instead of relying on one hit.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.productionHouse.title: Production House
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.relationships.p1: Professional relationships can change the quality of opportunities you see.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.relationships.p2: Personal relationships are not just flavor. Neglect can create drama, while healthy bonds support a stronger life path.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.relationships.p3: Networking works best over time. Repeated effort usually beats one expensive gesture.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.relationships.title: Relationships & Networking
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.releases.p1: Release life has stages: theatrical performance, streaming interest, library value, awards attention, and long-tail reputation.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.releases.p2: Streaming offers care about project value, audience fit, momentum, and platform appetite.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.releases.p3: Awards reward quality, performance strength, category fit, timing, and industry buzz.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.releases.title: Releases, Streaming & Awards
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.scriptFormats.p1: Format is the production shape, such as movie, series, live action, animated feature, or anime film.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.scriptFormats.p2: Genre is the audience promise, such as drama, action, biopic, sports, documentary, musical, animation, anime, or similar lanes.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.scriptFormats.p3: Primary genre carries the main identity. Secondary genre adds flavor and should support the project.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.scriptFormats.title: Scripts, Genres & Formats
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.social.p1: Social media keeps you visible and can support your broader entertainment career.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.social.p2: Different platforms do different jobs: image, reach, conversation, and monetization.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.social.p3: Use social with purpose. Not every post needs to chase virality.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.social.title: Fame, Followers & Social
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.stats.p1: Fame is your public profile. It helps you get seen, land bigger opportunities, and stay culturally relevant.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.stats.p2: Reputation is how seriously the industry takes you. High reputation supports trust and better long-term outcomes.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.stats.p3: Followers are your social reach. They help influence, sponsorships, and online growth, but they cannot carry an acting career alone.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.stats.p4: Mood and energy shape how much you can do. A rich account means less if your character is exhausted or unhappy.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.stats.title: Stats Explained
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.subtitle: A plain-language reference for how the game works, what each system is for, and when to care about it.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.title: Handbook
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.universes.p1: Big universes are prestige opportunities with high visibility and high competition.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.universes.p2: Smaller parts, cameos, or supporting appearances can become stepping stones.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.universes.p3: Character identity should carry across sequels, events, recasts, and crossovers.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.universes.p4: Preparation still matters. High profile roles are easier when career, cast plan, and studio setup are strong.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.universes.title: Franchises & Universes
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.weeklyLoop.p1: Energy is weekly fuel. Acting, social moves, business work, and personal actions all draw from it.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.weeklyLoop.p2: Do not waste empty weeks. If you are waiting on a project, build fame, relationships, skills, or business progress.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.weeklyLoop.p3: Recovery has value. Sometimes restoring your character makes the next few weeks stronger.
englishTranslations.guide.handbook.weeklyLoop.title: Weekly Loop & Energy
